source_hash_method: SHA256 of sorted src/**/*.rs, Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, build.rs; each relative path, NUL, bytes, NUL
notes: All A/B performance baselines include the reentrant-write correctness fix. Candidate adds the reactor polling change to that baseline.
Release builds without profiler; no builds/tests/profiling concurrent with timed benchmark processes. Host services active, frequency not fixed, CPU affinity 0-15.
Focused probes: rotating loop order, one discarded process block, seven measured blocks. Matrix: alternating A/B, seven fresh-process blocks, two in-process warmups per measurement.

Native TCP A/B: nine alternating fresh-process pairs, default 5000 round trips and 1024-byte payload, no discarded process block. Standard competitor microbenchmarks: seven fresh-process measurements after two warmups per loop/workload; descriptive, not paired A/B.

Idle: eight alternating pairs, 200 connections, five discarded cycles and 20 measured cycles, 10ms idle; per-process medians retained. CPU sanity check: seven alternating fresh-process pairs, process CPU includes loop startup/shutdown around asyncio.sleep(0.5).
Approximate 95% process-block log-ratio bootstrap intervals, 10000 samples, seed 0, 3% threshold; no multiple-comparison adjustment.
Request-level latencies omitted; matrix p95/p99 and RSS and idle per-run milestone medians retained. Compact evidence bundle is not input to check_regression.py.
Unconditional polling was rejected after a measured native-fast-stream regression; its diagnostic TCP A/B is retained separately.

focused.label: reactor-during-spin-cooldown
focused.method: fresh process per scenario/run; rotating loop order; first block discarded

matrix.method:
Interleave baseline/candidate wheels in fresh workload-matrix processes.

Each process performs two discarded warmups and one measured run. Every run
uses 16 connections and 500 requests per connection. This supplements the
standard sustained matrix with independent, alternating A/B process blocks.
